package ui

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Synthetic native UI fixtures only. No model, files, or external clipboard.
func TestOrbitSelectionRetainsVirtualizedSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	var list ListState
	var parts []SelectedText
	identity := "session-a"
	value := "first 用户文字"
	show, enabled, retain := true, true, true
	build := func(c *Context) {
		Column(c).Size(500, 240).Children(func() {
			if show {
				scope := Column(c.Key("retained")).Height(180).Width(500).Selectable().Disabled(!enabled)
				if retain {
					scope.RetainTextSelection(identity)
				}
				scope.Children(func() {
					List(c, &list, 80, func(i int) {
						s := fmt.Sprintf("Row %02d 用户文字", i)
						if i == 0 {
							s = value
						}
						Text(c, s).Height(40)
					}).Grow(1)
				})
				parts = scope.SelectedTexts()
			} else {
				parts = nil
			}
			TextInput(c.Key("outside"), new(string)).Label("Outside input")
		})
	}
	tt := NewTester(build, 500, 240)
	selectRows := func() {
		t.Helper()
		a, ok := tt.Find(value)
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("missing first row")
		}
		b, ok := tt.Find("Row 02 用户文字")
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("missing third row")
		}
		tt.Press(a.X+1, a.Y+10)
		tt.Move(b.X+b.W-1, b.Y+10)
		tt.Release(b.X+b.W-1, b.Y+10)
	}
	selectRows()
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	original := value + "\nRow 01 用户文字\nRow 02 用户文字"
	if tt.Clipboard() != original {
		t.Fatalf("initial selection %q", tt.Clipboard())
	}
	baselineStates := len(tt.rt.states)
	list.ScrollToEnd()
	tt.Frame()
	tt.SetClipboard("sentinel")
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if tt.Clipboard() != original || len(parts) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unmounted selection lost: %q %v", tt.Clipboard(), parts)
	}
	if _, ok := tt.Find(value); ok {
		t.Fatalf("virtualization disabled: %v", tt.Texts())
	}
	if len(tt.rt.states) > baselineStates+5 {
		t.Fatalf("retained nodes: before=%d after=%d", baselineStates, len(tt.rt.states))
	}
	for id, s := range tt.rt.states {
		if s.seen != tt.rt.frame {
			t.Fatalf("stale UI node %d retained", id)
		}
	}
	list.ScrollTo(0, Start)
	tt.Frame()
	a, _ := tt.Find(value)
	// A matching remounted paragraph must have the exact selected range.
	var painted bool
	for _, s := range tt.rt.texts {
		if s.editor.source == value {
			painted = s.editor.anchor == 0 && s.editor.caret == len([]rune(value))
		}
	}
	if !painted {
		t.Fatal("remounted highlight not restored")
	}
	// Immutable copied text survives streaming append/replacement. Highlights are
	// clamped against current text, as Rust range_for does.
	value = "替"
	tt.Frame()
	tt.SetClipboard("sentinel")
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if tt.Clipboard() != original {
		t.Fatal("later content replaced immutable snapshot")
	}
	for _, s := range tt.rt.texts {
		if s.editor.source == value && (s.editor.anchor > 1 || s.editor.caret > 1) {
			t.Fatal("unclamped highlight")
		}
	}
	identity = "session-b"
	tt.Frame()
	tt.SetClipboard("sentinel")
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if len(parts) != 0 || tt.Clipboard() != "sentinel" {
		t.Fatal("selection leaked across session identity")
	}
	value = "first 用户文字"
	tt.Frame()
	selectRows()
	tt.Click("Outside input")
	tt.Frame()
	if len(parts) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("outside click retained selection")
	}
	selectRows()
	enabled = false
	tt.Frame()
	if tt.rt.selection.blocks != nil {
		t.Fatal("disabled scope retained selection")
	}
	enabled = true
	tt.Frame()
	selectRows()
	retain = false
	tt.Frame()
	if tt.rt.selection.blocks != nil {
		t.Fatal("removed opt-in retained selection")
	}
	retain = true
	tt.Frame()
	selectRows()
	show = false
	tt.Frame()
	if tt.rt.selection.blocks != nil {
		t.Fatal("removed scope retained snapshot")
	}
	_ = a
}

func TestOrbitSelectionSnapshotDragGutterAndDefaultIsolation(t *testing.T) {
	var list ListState
	var parts []SelectedText
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		scope := Column(c).Size(500, 180).Selectable().RetainTextSelection("drag")
		scope.Children(func() {
			List(c, &list, 80, func(i int) { Text(c, fmt.Sprintf("Row %02d", i)).Width(300).Height(40) }).Grow(1)
		})
		parts = scope.SelectedTexts()
	}, 500, 180)
	a, _ := tt.Find("Row 00")
	b, _ := tt.Find("Row 02")
	tt.Press(a.X+1, a.Y+10)
	// A row's padding/gutter belongs to its block, not the wider previous text.
	tt.Move(b.X+250, b.Y+10)
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	expected := "Row 00\nRow 01\nRow 02"
	if tt.Clipboard() != expected {
		t.Fatalf("gutter selection=%q", tt.Clipboard())
	}
	captured := len(tt.rt.selection.blocks)
	list.ScrollToEnd()
	tt.Frame()
	last, _ := tt.Find("Row 79")
	tt.Move(last.X+last.W-1, last.Y+10)
	tt.Release(last.X+last.W-1, last.Y+10)
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if tt.Clipboard() != expected || len(tt.rt.selection.blocks) != captured || len(parts) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("drag captured newly mounted blocks unlike source")
	}
	// Replacing the selection after a scroll must discard the old block set.
	tt.Press(last.X+1, last.Y+10)
	tt.Move(last.X+last.W-1, last.Y+10)
	tt.Release(last.X+last.W-1, last.Y+10)
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if !strings.Contains(tt.Clipboard(), "Row 79") || strings.Contains(tt.Clipboard(), "Row 00") {
		t.Fatal("new selection copied stale snapshot")
	}
}

func TestOrbitSelectionCopyPriorityContextMenuAndReset(t *testing.T) {
	var input = "composer selection"
	focusInput := false
	var scopeID uint64
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		Column(c).Size(400, 240).Children(func() {
			scope := Column(c.Key("scope")).Size(400, 160).RetainTextSelection("menu-fixture")
			scopeID = scope.ID()
			scope.Children(func() {
				Text(c, "First 用户").Height(40)
				Text(c, "Second row").Height(40)
				Text(c, "Third untouched").Height(40)
			})
			scope.ContextMenu(func(m *Menu) {
				if m.Item("Copy Selection").Disabled(len(scope.SelectedTexts()) == 0).Chosen() {
					c.WriteClipboard("menu:" + strings.Join(func() []string {
						var out []string
						for _, p := range scope.SelectedTexts() {
							out = append(out, string([]rune(p.Text)[p.Start:p.End]))
						}
						return out
					}(), "\n"))
				}
			})
			editor := TextInput(c, &input).Label("composer")
			if focusInput {
				editor.Focus()
			}
		})
	}, 400, 240)
	a, _ := tt.Find("First 用户")
	b, _ := tt.Find("Second row")
	tt.Press(a.X+1, a.Y+10)
	tt.Move(b.X+b.W-1, b.Y+10)
	tt.Release(b.X+b.W-1, b.Y+10)
	focusInput = true
	tt.Frame()
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyA)
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if tt.Clipboard() != "First 用户\nSecond row" {
		t.Fatalf("source copy priority lost: %q", tt.Clipboard())
	}
	// Right-clicking even an unselected location within the same transcript
	// leaves the source snapshot intact and offers the selected copy action.
	focusInput = false
	if err := tt.RightClick("Third untouched"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := tt.ChooseMenuItem("Copy Selection"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if tt.Clipboard() != "menu:First 用户\nSecond row" {
		t.Fatalf("menu selection %q", tt.Clipboard())
	}
	tt.RightClick("Third untouched")
	tt.Key(0, KeyEscape)
	if tt.rt.selection.scope != scopeID {
		t.Fatal("menu dismissal cleared selection")
	}
	if err := tt.Click("composer"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyA)
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if tt.Clipboard() != input {
		t.Fatal("cleared transcript selection stole input copy")
	}
}

func TestOrbitSelectionUTF8SnapshotOffsetsAfterRewrite(t *testing.T) {
	text := "ab 用户"
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		Column(c).Size(300, 120).RetainTextSelection("unicode").Children(func() { Text(c, text).Height(50) })
	}, 300, 120)
	box, _ := tt.Find(text)
	tt.Press(box.X+1, box.Y+10)
	tt.Move(box.X+box.W-1, box.Y+10)
	tt.Release(box.X+box.W-1, box.Y+10)
	tt.rt.selection.anchor.at, tt.rt.selection.caret.at = 1, 2 // snapshot bytes [1,2), "b"
	text = "é 用户"                                              // byte 1 is now inside é; source clamps backward to byte 0.
	tt.Frame()
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if tt.Clipboard() != "b" {
		t.Fatalf("snapshot changed %q", tt.Clipboard())
	}
	for _, s := range tt.rt.texts {
		if s.editor.source == text && (s.editor.anchor != 0 || s.editor.caret != 1) {
			t.Fatalf("UTF-8 range not source-clamped: %d %d", s.editor.anchor, s.editor.caret)
		}
	}
}
